standard_prerequisites.name: Integral scheme over a decent space
standard_prerequisites.use: Surjective integral (hence finite) Y -> X with local factors through U.

standard_prerequisites.name: Integral limit is a limit of finite fp morphisms
standard_prerequisites.use: Y = lim Y_i with Y_i -> X finite and of finite presentation.

standard_prerequisites.name: Limits that are schemes and descended opens
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: lemma-limit-is-scheme (same chapter, cited at ~3806-3807); lemma-descend-opens (same chapter, cited at ~3808-3810)
standard_prerequisites.use: Y_i is a scheme for large i; affine opens V_{i,j} in Y_i recovering V_j.

standard_prerequisites.name: Morphisms appear at finite stages
standard_prerequisites.use: V_j -> U over X comes from V_{i,j} -> U for i large.

core_obligations: 归约：(1) 是 (2) 取 U=X 的特例；取 integral Y→X（decent-spaces 引理）与因子化过 U 的有限仿射开覆盖 V_j（~3798-3802 行）。

极限四步：Y=lim Y_i（finite fp，引 integral-limit 引理）；大 i 时 Y_i 是概形（limit-is-scheme）；更大 i 时 V_{i,j}⊂Y_i 仿射开恢复 V_j（descend-opens）；再大 i 时 V_j→U 来自 V_{i,j}→U（characterize-locally-finite-presentation L26289）（~3803-3815 行）。
proof_roadmap: (1) 化归为 (2) 特例 + integral 覆盖（~3798-3802 行）。
四步极限组装：概形性、开恢复、态射表出（~3803-3815 行）。
